scripts.setup: bun install && cd cli && bun install && bun run build && node dist/cli.mjs install
scripts.build:firefox: BROWSER_TARGET=firefox vite build && BROWSER_TARGET=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.dev: vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development && (vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & vite build --watch --mode development)
scripts.dev:firefox: BROWSER_TARGET=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development && (BROWSER_TARGET=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & BROWSER_TARGET=firefox vite build --watch --mode development)
scripts.build-for-amo: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir release/firefox --ignore-files relay-pairing.json --overwrite-dest
scripts.test: umask 022 && bun test ./test && cd cli && bun test
